breadcrumbs.name: MIFARE Ultralight C Cards — 3des-authenticated NFC Cards For Transit & Access In Bulk

summary: MIFARE Ultralight C is NXP's entry-level NFC card with 3DES mutual authentication — offering meaningful security at a cost point suitable for high-volume disposable applications such as transit single-use tickets, event wristbands, loyalty punch cards and short-term access credentials. Available in bulk orders with optional NDEF pre-encoding and custom printing.
